data.title: As a project owner, my legacy dso-config.conf auto-migrates to v2 idempotently and safely

content.text: **What**: When a v2-aware consumer reads dso-config.conf with legacy singular `stack=`, rewrite to v2 array using flock advisory file lock + mktemp + mv atomic rename. Idempotent on v2 configs.
**Why**: Existing user configs must migrate without manual edits and without races between concurrent consumers.

- IN: Migration helper (auto-invoked on first read); flock-guarded atomic write (mktemp -> mv); v1->v2 rewrite with audit comment; idempotency on already-v2; missing trailing newline handled; malformed YAML rejected with file:line error; comments preserved; multiple `stack=` lines rejected; empty `stack=` migrated to `unknown`; EROFS read-only filesystem -> in-memory translation + `[DSO WARN]` log.
- OUT: detect-stack.sh changes (separate story); consumer migrations (separate stories).
- When complete, a v1 dso-config.conf is rewritten to v2 in-place atomically on first read by a v2-aware consumer ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, re-reading a v2 config is a no-op (idempotent) ← Satisfies: SC2

- When complete, edge-case round-trip tests pass: missing trailing newline, malformed YAML rejected with file:line, comments preserved, multiple `stack=` rejected, empty `stack=` -> `unknown`, EROFS graceful fallback with warn-log ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
- [Reliability] Concurrent race: flock + atomic mktemp/mv mandatory; cover concurrent-read scenario in tests
- [Reliability] EROFS fallback must not error out — degrade to in-memory translation with WARN
- [Testing] Round-trip tests must enumerate every edge case from the epic SC2

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
